descriptionMarkdown:
- Required Materials to kickstart are pre listed in the hub just check the box at Nauvis to request for them

Recommended Tech Levels

- Laser damage: minimum level 12, recommended level 13

- Explosive damage: minimum level 10, recommended level 12

- Asteroid reprocessing: works fine at level 3 or 4, recommended level 5

- Railgun damage and shooting speed: can run at level 1, recommended level 2

Additional Notes

- The fuel decider combinators are set to 2, which keeps speed steady at 80 km/s. At this setting the ship takes zero damage so long as your rocket and railguns have had a little time to get stocked up. 

- Once stocked up you can drop it to 1 or remove the fuel combinators and get over 100 km/s without taking damage

- Storage has been added for a preset of 1400 promethium rocks before they start getting chucked overboard. ship has 1539 storage capability

- Makes promethium science 

- The goal of this ship is simple: paste the blueprint, build it, and go all the way to the shattered planet without needing to remove any parts of the ship for kickstarting or needing to make any tedious quality items.
 
If you have any questions, let me know. I will respond quickly and update if needed.

Thank you and enjoy!
title: Shattered Planet Ship - No Quality + No  Complicated Kickstart
